title: Net profit KPIs omit COGS
expected: Net profit includes COGS and official ledger balances
actual: netProfit is sales minus operating expenses only
accounting_impact: Profit margin and EBITDA can be overstated
reproduction_steps: Create owned sale with positive costAmount
suggested_fix: Derive KPI from ledger/P&L

title: Operating cash flow double-counts receipts
expected: Period cash flow from classified cash movements
actual: ending cash balance is combined with paidTotal and expenses
accounting_impact: Cash-flow health can be materially wrong
reproduction_steps: Compare ending cash and Financial Health OCF
suggested_fix: Build OCF from period movements

title: Current liabilities omit credit purchase AP
expected: Current ratio includes AP and payable checks
actual: payables KPI uses payableDocs/opening payables
suggested_fix: Use ledger current-liability balances

title: Negative equity is masked
expected: Negative/zero equity is preserved
actual: equity is clamped with Math.max(...,1)
suggested_fix: Preserve signed equity and handle undefined ratio

title: Assigned checks counted as receivable assets
expected: Assigned checks leave check-receivable asset
actual: assignedTo checks are added to receivables KPI
suggested_fix: Use ledger receivable balances

title: 31–60 aging bucket mislabeled
expected: 31–60 days label
actual: duplicate 61–90 label
suggested_fix: Correct label

title: Aging uses invoice date instead of due date
expected: Overdue days measured from contractual due date
actual: age is measured from invoice date
suggested_fix: Persist/use dueDate

title: Invoice number edit can orphan/duplicate links
expected: Stable ID and conflict-safe renumbering
actual: new id is generated and cleanup filters by new number
reproduction_steps: Inspect old invoice and linked rows
suggested_fix: Preserve stable ID and use original key for cleanup

title: Owned sale can omit COGS
expected: COGS required or derived for owned inventory sale
actual: zero costAmount is accepted and no COGS voucher is derived
suggested_fix: Require/derive inventory valuation cost

title: Tax Excel totals are inconsistent with rows
expected: Taxable-base/VAT totals reconcile to filtered rows
actual: gross totals and net VAT are placed in incompatible columns
suggested_fix: Separate taxable base, output VAT, input VAT and net VAT

title: Non-financial incoming items included in purchase aggregate
expected: Consignment/nonfinancial entries excluded or separated
actual: all incoming invoice amounts enter purchase aggregate
suggested_fix: Separate financial purchases from nonfinancial incoming

title: Posted/lifecycle checks can be hard-deleted
expected: Void/cancel with retained history
actual: Delete filters document from workspace
suggested_fix: Void with reason/user/timestamp; no physical delete

title: Posted financial invoice can be hard-deleted
expected: Void/reversal preserving source
actual: removeInvoice physically removes source and links
accounting_impact: Posted source audit trail is lost
suggested_fix: Add immutable posted/voided workflow

title: Production UI exposes full finance reset
expected: Irreversible reset blocked in normal Production
actual: resetAllFinance replaces workspace with emptyFinance after browser confirms
accounting_impact: Entire active financial workspace can be erased
reproduction_steps: Inspect Initial Data reset control; do not execute in Production
suggested_fix: Maintenance-only archival/reset with backup and re-auth

title: Duplicate checks can be saved after confirmation
expected: Accounting uniqueness is enforced
actual: duplicate warning can be overridden
suggested_fix: Hard uniqueness with appropriate composite key

title: Transfer direction is inverted
expected: A→B decreases A and increases B; Dr B / Cr A
actual: default transfer direction in debits A and credits B
accounting_impact: Bank balances and ledger transfer are reversed
suggested_fix: Normalize transfer source/destination semantics; transfer should post out from source

title: Reversal uses current date
expected: Open-period correction reverses in original accounting period
actual: reverseLedgerEntry uses time.Now()
suggested_fix: Keep original date; reject if period closed; staged migration 020

title: Bounced/returned checks reduce credit exposure
expected: Bad checks increase risk and do not count as collectible
actual: future-check filter excludes only cleared/assigned
suggested_fix: Count only collectible states; penalize bounced/returned

title: Bad checks counted as expected liquidity
expected: Bounced/returned checks excluded from expected receipts
actual: advisor filters exclude only cleared/assigned
suggested_fix: Shared collectible-check policy

title: Payment-term percentages can exceed 100
expected: Configured settlement percentages reconcile to 100
actual: check percent can be edited without normalizing cash percent
accounting_impact: Collection forecast can exceed invoice debt
suggested_fix: Validate/normalize percentage total

title: Stored passwords are recoverable/displayed
expected: Password is non-recoverable after creation
actual: portal decrypts and returns stored passwords to management UI
accounting_impact: Credential compromise can lead to unauthorized financial access
suggested_fix: One-time new password display only; otherwise reset flow

title: Human owner and service-account responsibilities are conflated
expected: Human owner identity separate from least-privilege integration identity
actual: production incident shows role restriction/repair around a service-account-tagged identity
accounting_impact: Privilege drift or accidental owner lockout
reproduction_steps: Inspect tenant access records and service-account mapping
suggested_fix: Separate identities; make Portal the permission authority
